name: Baldwin Park City Council Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL  Mayor  Emmanuel J. Estrada
REGULAR MEETING  Mayor Pro Tem  Jean M. Ayala
  Councilmember  Alejandra Avila
Notice of Cancellation  Councilmember  Daniel Damian
  Councilmember  Monica Garcia
January 17, 2024, 7:00 PM

  NOTICE OF MEETING
  CANCELLATION

  OF THE FOLLOWING:
  REGULAR MEETINGS OF THE CITY COUNCIL

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regularly scheduled meeting of
the City Council of the City of Baldwin Park scheduled for Wednesday,
January 17, 2024, has been CANCELLED.

  Said meeting was to be held in the Council Chambers,
  14403 E. Pacific Ave., Baldwin Park CA, at 7:00 pm.

  The Next Regular Meeting of the City Council is scheduled for
  Wednesday, February 7, 2024, at 7:00 pm, Council Chambers,
14403 E. Pacific Ave., Baldwin Park, CA.

  Notice of Cancellation was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting.
  Dated this 11th day of January 2024

  Shirley Quiñones,
  Chief Deputy City Clerk
